user_text: EXAMPLE_ONLY: on Level 1 add a vertical square column from (1000, 2000, 0) mm to (1000, 2000, 3000) mm with 500 mm width and depth and create a new dedicated Column Type
rule: a requested new, generated or dedicated Type keeps prototype_intent null because generated Type identity is program-derived; axis points are section centers in Storey-local millimetres; square section orientation is not inferred or required; the Storey itself is selected with target_query.names, never storey_name
